title: A.S.K. When Prayer Feels Stuck
hook: Prayed and nothing happened? Try what Jesus said to do next.
script: Prayed and nothing happened? Try what Jesus said to do next. In Luke 11, a man keeps knocking at midnight until the door opens. In Luke 18, a widow refuses to quit until justice comes. In Daniel 10, the answer was sent day one, but there was a fight in the unseen. Unanswered doesn’t always mean unheard. Jesus taught A.S.K.: Ask specifically, Seek persistently, Knock expectantly. Bring the same prayer back tomorrow, and the next day, with faith, not frenzy. God isn’t annoyed by your knocking; He’s building your trust. Stay at the door. The story isn’t over.

title: From Silence to Guidance
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. Sometimes it isn’t God’s distance, it’s our direction. James 4:3 says we ask and don’t receive because motives drift. Try this today: get specific, then surrender. Pray, Father, I desire this, but align my want with Your will. Open what leads me to love You and people more; close what won’t. Then seek—open Scripture, listen in quiet, ask wise believers. And knock by taking the next small obedient step. Jesus promised in Luke 11:9-10 that askers receive, seekers find, and knockers see doors open. Silence can turn into guidance when your heart is aimed at Him.

title: Waiting or Warfare?
hook: If you're tired of waiting on God, listen to this.
script: If you're tired of waiting on God, listen to this. In Daniel 10, God answered on day one, but the delivery was delayed by a spiritual battle. Your waiting may be warfare, not a no. So follow Jesus’ rhythm: A is Ask specifically—name the mountain. S is Seek persistently—show up daily, even when feelings don’t. K is Knock expectantly—act on the light you have and watch for the next door. Keep your heart soft, forgive quickly, and stay humble; pride jams the pipeline. Your consistency is faith in motion. I made a simple 7‑day prayer tracker to help you keep going this week.
